3SV_FIN_CORE_ACTUALS_BS_SEED_ENRICHED_01.@EndUserText.label: 3SV_FIN_CORE_ACTUALS_BS_SEED_ENRICHED_01
3SV_FIN_CORE_ACTUALS_BS_SEED_ENRICHED_01.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
    Q."COMPANY_CODE"  AS "D_XPA_COMPANY_CODE_ID",
    Q."GL_ACCOUNT"    AS "D_XPA_GL_ACCOUNT_ID",
    Q."SOURCE_LEDGER" AS "SOURCE_LEDGER",

    CASE
        WHEN Q."SEED_ROW_COUNT" = 0 THEN 'SEED_PENDING_MIGRATED_S4'
        WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED"  = 1 THEN 'SEED_AVAILABLE'
        ELSE 'INVALID_OR_DUPLICATE_SEED'
    END AS "OPENING_SEED_STATUS",

    CASE WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 1 THEN Q."VALID_SEED_RECORD_ID"                ELSE NULL END AS "VALID_SEED_RECORD_ID",
    CASE WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 1 THEN Q."OPENING_DATE"                        ELSE NULL END AS "OPENING_DATE",
    CASE WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 1 THEN Q."OPENING_BALANCE_RAW"                 ELSE NULL END AS "OPENING_BALANCE_RAW",
    CASE WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 1 THEN Q."SEED_MOVEMENT_TREATMENT"             ELSE NULL END AS "SEED_MOVEMENT_TREATMENT",
    CASE WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 1 THEN Q."MIGRATION_SOURCE_REFERENCE"          ELSE NULL END AS "MIGRATION_SOURCE_REFERENCE",
    CASE WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 1 THEN Q."MIGRATION_POSTING_DATE"              ELSE NULL END AS "MIGRATION_POSTING_DATE",
    CASE WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 1 THEN Q."MIGRATION_POSTING_MONTH"             ELSE NULL END AS "MIGRATION_POSTING_MONTH",
    CASE WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 1 THEN Q."MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_RAW"    ELSE NULL END AS "MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_RAW",
    CASE WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 1 THEN Q."MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_SIGNED" ELSE NULL END AS "MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_SIGNED",
    CASE WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 1 THEN Q."MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_STATUS"     ELSE NULL END AS "MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_STATUS",
    CASE WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 1 THEN Q."MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_REFERENCE"  ELSE NULL END AS "MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_REFERENCE",
    CASE WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 1 THEN Q."MIGRATION_RECONCILED_TIMESTAMP"      ELSE NULL END AS "MIGRATION_RECONCILED_TIMESTAMP",

    /* Migration-exclusion classification (logic unchanged).
       DATA CONTRACT: MIGRATION_POSTING_MONTH is a 'YYYYMM' string. */
    CASE
        WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 0
            THEN 'NOT_REQUIRED'

        WHEN Q."SEED_MOVEMENT_TREATMENT" = 'NO_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_REQUIRED'
            THEN 'NOT_REQUIRED'

        WHEN Q."SEED_MOVEMENT_TREATMENT" = 'EXCLUDE_MIGRATION_POSTING'
         AND NULLIF(TRIM(Q."MIGRATION_SOURCE_REFERENCE"), '') IS NOT NULL
         AND Q."MIGRATION_POSTING_DATE" IS NOT NULL
         AND NULLIF(TRIM(Q."MIGRATION_POSTING_MONTH"), '') IS NOT NULL
         AND TO_NVARCHAR(Q."MIGRATION_POSTING_DATE", 'YYYYMM') = Q."MIGRATION_POSTING_MONTH"
         AND Q."MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_RAW" IS NOT NULL
         AND Q."MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_SIGNED" IS NOT NULL
         AND NULLIF(TRIM(Q."MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_STATUS"), '') = 'RECONCILED'
         AND NULLIF(TRIM(Q."MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_REFERENCE"), '') IS NOT NULL
         AND Q."MIGRATION_RECONCILED_TIMESTAMP" IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'RECONCILED'

        WHEN Q."SEED_MOVEMENT_TREATMENT" = 'EXCLUDE_MIGRATION_POSTING'
         AND NULLIF(TRIM(Q."MIGRATION_SOURCE_REFERENCE"), '') IS NOT NULL
         AND Q."MIGRATION_POSTING_DATE" IS NOT NULL
         AND NULLIF(TRIM(Q."MIGRATION_POSTING_MONTH"), '') IS NOT NULL
         AND TO_NVARCHAR(Q."MIGRATION_POSTING_DATE", 'YYYYMM') = Q."MIGRATION_POSTING_MONTH"
         AND Q."MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_RAW" IS NOT NULL
         AND Q."MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_SIGNED" IS NOT NULL
         AND NULLIF(TRIM(Q."MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_STATUS"), '') = 'PENDING'
            THEN 'PENDING_RECONCILIATION'

        WHEN Q."SEED_MOVEMENT_TREATMENT" = 'EXCLUDE_MIGRATION_POSTING'
            THEN 'INVALID_EXCLUSION'

        ELSE 'NOT_REQUIRED'
    END AS "MIGRATION_EXCLUSION_STATUS",

    CASE WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 1 THEN Q."SEED_ACCOUNT_CLASS"         ELSE NULL END AS "SEED_ACCOUNT_CLASS",
    CASE WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 1 THEN Q."SEED_REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR" ELSE NULL END AS "SEED_REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR",

    /* ===== OPTIONAL DIAGNOSTICS ÔÇö delete this block (and the comma
       above) to keep the original output signature unchanged. ===== */
    Q."SEED_ROW_COUNT"             AS "DIAG_SEED_ROW_COUNT",
    Q."ACTIVE_EFFECTIVE_ROW_COUNT" AS "DIAG_ACTIVE_EFFECTIVE_ROW_COUNT",
    Q."VALID_LEDGER_COUNT"         AS "DIAG_VALID_LEDGER_COUNT",
    Q."VALID_TREATMENT_COUNT"      AS "DIAG_VALID_TREATMENT_COUNT",
    Q."VALID_V3_START_COUNT"       AS "DIAG_VALID_V3_START_COUNT",
    Q."VALID_RECORD_COUNT"         AS "DIAG_VALID_RECORD_COUNT",
    CASE
        WHEN Q."IS_VALID_SEED" = 1              THEN 'VALID'
        WHEN Q."SEED_ROW_COUNT" = 0             THEN 'NO_SEED_ROWS'
        WHEN Q."ACTIVE_EFFECTIVE_ROW_COUNT" = 0 THEN 'NO_ACTIVE_EFFECTIVE_ROW'
        WHEN Q."ACTIVE_EFFECTIVE_ROW_COUNT" > 1 THEN 'DUPLICATE_ACTIVE_EFFECTIVE_ROWS'
        WHEN Q."VALID_LEDGER_COUNT" <> 1        THEN 'NON_0L_LEDGER'
        WHEN Q."VALID_TREATMENT_COUNT" <> 1     THEN 'INVALID_MOVEMENT_TREATMENT'
        WHEN Q."VALID_V3_START_COUNT" <> 1      THEN 'OPENING_DATE_NOT_V3_PERIOD_START'
        WHEN Q."VALID_RECORD_COUNT" <> 1        THEN 'ACCOUNT_CLASS_OR_SIGN_RULE_UNRESOLVED'
        ELSE 'UNCLASSIFIED_INVALID'
    END AS "DIAG_SEED_VALIDATION_REASON"
    /* ===== end optional diagnostics block ===== */

FROM (
    /* QUALIFIED: validity gate computed EXACTLY ONCE. */
    SELECT
        D."COMPANY_CODE",
        D."GL_ACCOUNT",
        D."SOURCE_LEDGER",
        COALESCE(AC."SEED_ROW_COUNT", 0)             AS "SEED_ROW_COUNT",
        COALESCE(AC."ACTIVE_EFFECTIVE_ROW_COUNT", 0) AS "ACTIVE_EFFECTIVE_ROW_COUNT",
        COALESCE(EC."VALID_LEDGER_COUNT", 0)         AS "VALID_LEDGER_COUNT",
        COALESCE(EC."VALID_TREATMENT_COUNT", 0)      AS "VALID_TREATMENT_COUNT",
        COALESCE(EC."VALID_V3_START_COUNT", 0)       AS "VALID_V3_START_COUNT",
        COALESCE(VR."VALID_RECORD_COUNT", 0)         AS "VALID_RECORD_COUNT",
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(AC."ACTIVE_EFFECTIVE_ROW_COUNT", 0) = 1
             AND COALESCE(EC."VALID_LEDGER_COUNT", 0)         = 1
             AND COALESCE(EC."VALID_TREATMENT_COUNT", 0)      = 1
             AND COALESCE(EC."VALID_V3_START_COUNT", 0)       = 1
             AND COALESCE(VR."VALID_RECORD_COUNT", 0)         = 1
                THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS "IS_VALID_SEED",
        VR."VALID_SEED_RECORD_ID",
        VR."OPENING_DATE",
        VR."OPENING_BALANCE_RAW",
        VR."SEED_MOVEMENT_TREATMENT",
        VR."MIGRATION_SOURCE_REFERENCE",
        VR."MIGRATION_POSTING_DATE",
        VR."MIGRATION_POSTING_MONTH",
        VR."MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_RAW",
        VR."MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_SIGNED",
        VR."MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_STATUS",
        VR."MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_REFERENCE",
        VR."MIGRATION_RECONCILED_TIMESTAMP",
        VR."SEED_ACCOUNT_CLASS",
        VR."SEED_REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR"

    FROM (
        /* Driver key set. UNION already de-duplicates.
           NOTE (open design point): non-0L actuals keys can never reach
           SEED_AVAILABLE ÔÇö add SOURCE_LEDGER = '0L' filters here if only
           0L is in scope for the opening seed. */
        SELECT
            S."COMPANY_CODE",
            S."GL_ACCOUNT",
            S."SOURCE_LEDGER"
        FROM "MODELLING.2LT_FIN_BS_OPENING_SEED_S4_01" S

        UNION

        SELECT
            A."D_XPA_COMPANY_CODE_ID" AS "COMPANY_CODE",
            A."D_XPA_GL_ACCOUNT_ID"   AS "GL_ACCOUNT",
            A."SOURCE_LEDGER"
        FROM "3SV_FIN_CORE_ACTUALS_BS_MONTHLY_01" A
    ) D

    LEFT JOIN (
        /* AC: total and active-effective seed row counts per key. */
        SELECT
            S."COMPANY_CODE",
            S."GL_ACCOUNT",
            S."SOURCE_LEDGER",
            COUNT(*) AS "SEED_ROW_COUNT",
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN S."IS_ACTIVE" = TRUE
                     AND S."OPENING_DATE" IS NOT NULL
                     AND (S."VALID_FROM" IS NULL OR S."VALID_FROM" <= S."OPENING_DATE")
                     AND (S."VALID_TO"   IS NULL OR S."VALID_TO"   >= S."OPENING_DATE")
                        THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS "ACTIVE_EFFECTIVE_ROW_COUNT"
        FROM "MODELLING.2LT_FIN_BS_OPENING_SEED_S4_01" S
        GROUP BY
            S."COMPANY_CODE",
            S."GL_ACCOUNT",
            S."SOURCE_LEDGER"
    ) AC
        ON  AC."COMPANY_CODE"  = D."COMPANY_CODE"
        AND AC."GL_ACCOUNT"    = D."GL_ACCOUNT"
        AND AC."SOURCE_LEDGER" = D."SOURCE_LEDGER"

    LEFT JOIN (
        /* EC: eligibility counts over active-effective rows. */
        SELECT
            E."COMPANY_CODE",
            E."GL_ACCOUNT",
            E."SOURCE_LEDGER",
            SUM(CASE WHEN E."SOURCE_LEDGER" = '0L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "VALID_LEDGER_COUNT",
            SUM(CASE WHEN E."SEED_MOVEMENT_TREATMENT" IN ('EXCLUDE_MIGRATION_POSTING', 'NO_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_REQUIRED')
                     THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "VALID_TREATMENT_COUNT",
            SUM(CASE WHEN VC."FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "VALID_V3_START_COUNT"
        FROM (
            SELECT
                S."COMPANY_CODE",
                S."GL_ACCOUNT",
                S."SOURCE_LEDGER",
                S."OPENING_DATE",
                S."SEED_MOVEMENT_TREATMENT"
            FROM "MODELLING.2LT_FIN_BS_OPENING_SEED_S4_01" S
            WHERE S."IS_ACTIVE" = TRUE
              AND S."OPENING_DATE" IS NOT NULL
              AND (S."VALID_FROM" IS NULL OR S."VALID_FROM" <= S."OPENING_DATE")
              AND (S."VALID_TO"   IS NULL OR S."VALID_TO"   >= S."OPENING_DATE")
        ) E
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                TO_DATE(CAL."FiscalPeriodStartDate", 'YYYYMMDD') AS "FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE"
            FROM "3GV_DIM_FISCALCALENDAR_01" CAL
            WHERE CAL."FiscalYearVariant" = 'V3'
              AND CAL."Language"          = 'EN'
        ) VC
            ON VC."FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE" = E."OPENING_DATE"
        GROUP BY
            E."COMPANY_CODE",
            E."GL_ACCOUNT",
            E."SOURCE_LEDGER"
    ) EC
        ON  EC."COMPANY_CODE"  = D."COMPANY_CODE"
        AND EC."GL_ACCOUNT"    = D."GL_ACCOUNT"
        AND EC."SOURCE_LEDGER" = D."SOURCE_LEDGER"

    LEFT JOIN (
        /* VR: fully qualified candidate seed records per key.
           INVARIANT: MIN() is only safe because the outer gate enforces
           VALID_RECORD_COUNT = 1. Do not relax that gate without
           replacing MIN() with an explicit single-record pick. */
        SELECT
            X."COMPANY_CODE",
            X."GL_ACCOUNT",
            X."SOURCE_LEDGER",
            MIN(X."SEED_RECORD_ID")                      AS "VALID_SEED_RECORD_ID",
            MIN(X."OPENING_DATE")                        AS "OPENING_DATE",
            MIN(X."OPENING_BALANCE_RAW")                 AS "OPENING_BALANCE_RAW",
            MIN(X."SEED_MOVEMENT_TREATMENT")             AS "SEED_MOVEMENT_TREATMENT",
            MIN(X."MIGRATION_SOURCE_REFERENCE")          AS "MIGRATION_SOURCE_REFERENCE",
            MIN(X."MIGRATION_POSTING_DATE")              AS "MIGRATION_POSTING_DATE",
            MIN(X."MIGRATION_POSTING_MONTH")             AS "MIGRATION_POSTING_MONTH",
            MIN(X."MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_RAW")    AS "MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_RAW",
            MIN(X."MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_SIGNED") AS "MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_SIGNED",
            MIN(X."MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_STATUS")     AS "MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_STATUS",
            MIN(X."MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_REFERENCE")  AS "MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_REFERENCE",
            MIN(X."MIGRATION_RECONCILED_TIMESTAMP")      AS "MIGRATION_RECONCILED_TIMESTAMP",
            MIN(X."SEED_ACCOUNT_CLASS")                  AS "SEED_ACCOUNT_CLASS",
            MIN(X."SEED_REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR")          AS "SEED_REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR",
            COUNT(*)                                     AS "VALID_RECORD_COUNT"
        FROM (
            SELECT
                E."COMPANY_CODE",
                E."GL_ACCOUNT",
                E."SOURCE_LEDGER",
                E."SEED_RECORD_ID",
                E."OPENING_DATE",
                E."OPENING_BALANCE_RAW",
                E."SEED_MOVEMENT_TREATMENT",
                E."MIGRATION_SOURCE_REFERENCE",
                E."MIGRATION_POSTING_DATE",
                E."MIGRATION_POSTING_MONTH",
                E."MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_RAW",
                E."MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_SIGNED",
                E."MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_STATUS",
                E."MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_REFERENCE",
                E."MIGRATION_RECONCILED_TIMESTAMP",
                C."SEED_ACCOUNT_CLASS",
                C."SEED_REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR"
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    S."SEED_RECORD_ID",
                    S."COMPANY_CODE",
                    S."GL_ACCOUNT",
                    S."SOURCE_LEDGER",
                    S."OPENING_DATE",
                    S."OPENING_BALANCE_RAW",
                    S."SEED_MOVEMENT_TREATMENT",
                    S."MIGRATION_SOURCE_REFERENCE",
                    S."MIGRATION_POSTING_DATE",
                    S."MIGRATION_POSTING_MONTH",
                    S."MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_RAW",
                    S."MIGRATION_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_SIGNED",
                    S."MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_STATUS",
                    S."MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_REFERENCE",
                    S."MIGRATION_RECONCILED_TIMESTAMP"
                FROM "MODELLING.2LT_FIN_BS_OPENING_SEED_S4_01" S
                WHERE S."IS_ACTIVE" = TRUE
                  AND S."OPENING_DATE" IS NOT NULL
                  AND (S."VALID_FROM" IS NULL OR S."VALID_FROM" <= S."OPENING_DATE")
                  AND (S."VALID_TO"   IS NULL OR S."VALID_TO"   >= S."OPENING_DATE")
            ) E

            INNER JOIN (
                /* Account class + sign factor per seed record: valid only
                   where exactly ONE unambiguous effective-dated mapping
                   resolves to a BS class AND a sign factor of 1 / -1. */
                SELECT
                    MR."SEED_RECORD_ID",
                    MR."SEED_ACCOUNT_CLASS",
                    MR."SEED_REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR"
                FROM (
                    SELECT
                        E2."SEED_RECORD_ID",
                        CASE
                            WHEN COUNT(*) = 1
                             AND SUM(CASE WHEN GL."ACCOUNT_CLASS" IN ('ASSET', 'LIABILITY', 'EQUITY') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
                             AND SUM(CASE WHEN SR."REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR" IN (1, -1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
                                THEN MIN(GL."ACCOUNT_CLASS")
                            ELSE NULL
                        END AS "SEED_ACCOUNT_CLASS",
                        CASE
                            WHEN COUNT(*) = 1
                             AND SUM(CASE WHEN GL."ACCOUNT_CLASS" IN ('ASSET', 'LIABILITY', 'EQUITY') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
                             AND SUM(CASE WHEN SR."REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR" IN (1, -1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
                                THEN MIN(SR."REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR")
                            ELSE NULL
                        END AS "SEED_REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR"
                    FROM (
                        SELECT
                            S."SEED_RECORD_ID",
                            S."GL_ACCOUNT",
                            S."OPENING_DATE"
                        FROM "MODELLING.2LT_FIN_BS_OPENING_SEED_S4_01" S
                        WHERE S."IS_ACTIVE" = TRUE
                          AND S."OPENING_DATE" IS NOT NULL
                          AND (S."VALID_FROM" IS NULL OR S."VALID_FROM" <= S."OPENING_DATE")
                          AND (S."VALID_TO"   IS NULL OR S."VALID_TO"   >= S."OPENING_DATE")
                    ) E2

                    LEFT JOIN "MODELLING.2LT_CTRL_FIN_GL_ACCOUNT_CLASS_01" GL
                        ON GL."GL_ACCOUNT_ID" = E2."GL_ACCOUNT"
                       AND GL."IS_ACTIVE" = TRUE
                       AND (GL."VALID_FROM" IS NULL OR GL."VALID_FROM" <= E2."OPENING_DATE")
                       AND (GL."VALID_TO"   IS NULL OR GL."VALID_TO"   >= E2."OPENING_DATE")

                    LEFT JOIN "MODELLING.2LT_CTRL_FIN_ACCOUNT_CLASS_SIGN_RULE_01" SR
                        ON SR."ACCOUNT_CLASS" = GL."ACCOUNT_CLASS"
                       AND SR."IS_ACTIVE" = TRUE
                       AND (SR."VALID_FROM" IS NULL OR SR."VALID_FROM" <= E2."OPENING_DATE")
                       AND (SR."VALID_TO"   IS NULL OR SR."VALID_TO"   >= E2."OPENING_DATE")

                    GROUP BY
                        E2."SEED_RECORD_ID"
                ) MR
                WHERE MR."SEED_ACCOUNT_CLASS"         IS NOT NULL
                  AND MR."SEED_REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR" IS NOT NULL
            ) C
                ON C."SEED_RECORD_ID" = E."SEED_RECORD_ID"

            INNER JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    TO_DATE(CAL."FiscalPeriodStartDate", 'YYYYMMDD') AS "FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE"
                FROM "3GV_DIM_FISCALCALENDAR_01" CAL
                WHERE CAL."FiscalYearVariant" = 'V3'
                  AND CAL."Language"          = 'EN'
            ) VC
                ON VC."FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE" = E."OPENING_DATE"

            WHERE E."SOURCE_LEDGER" = '0L'
              AND E."SEED_MOVEMENT_TREATMENT" IN (
                  'EXCLUDE_MIGRATION_POSTING',
                  'NO_MOVEMENT_EXCLUSION_REQUIRED'
              )
        ) X
        GROUP BY
            X."COMPANY_CODE",
            X."GL_ACCOUNT",
            X."SOURCE_LEDGER"
    ) VR
        ON  VR."COMPANY_CODE"  = D."COMPANY_CODE"
        AND VR."GL_ACCOUNT"    = D."GL_ACCOUNT"
        AND VR."SOURCE_LEDGER" = D."SOURCE_LEDGER"
) Q
